# Ice Stone Service

> Ice Stone Service provides professional ice production, packaging, and delivery for bars, events, businesses, and private customers in Sardinia and in Mantova, Modena, and Reggio Emilia.

Ice Stone Service is an Italian ice supplier focused on fast delivery, event support, and cold-chain services. The website is primarily in Italian and includes separate routes for Sardinia and for Mantova, Modena, and Reggio Emilia.

- [Full LLM Guide](https://icestoneservice.it/llms-full.txt): Extended machine-readable guide with more detail about routes, services, products, and contact flows.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://icestoneservice.it/): Area selection landing page for Sardinia and mainland Italy service areas.
- [Home Italia](https://icestoneservice.it/home-italia): Main homepage for Mantova, Modena, and Reggio Emilia.
- [Home Sardegna](https://icestoneservice.it/home-sardegna): Main homepage for Sardinia.
